findings: ETT.tex:2067-2068: the « In particular » of lem:Sigma_separe needs neither ψ nor global hyperbolicity. Take any causal singular flat spacetime (abstractly SingularFlatAxioms, at M every causal, Hausdorff, second countable E_{>=0}-manifold) and any Cauchy surface Σ. Then J^±(Σ) are closed and J⁺(Σ) ∩ J⁻(Σ) = Σ. Both J⁺(Σ) ∖ Σ and J⁻(Σ) ∖ Σ are open, so each J^±(Σ) is a neighbourhood of its points outside Σ, the time-reversed half included, which the paper does not state. Also M = J⁺(Σ) ∪ J⁻(Σ) and Σ is closed (Causal.Causality.SingularFlatAxioms.sigma_separe_of_isCausal; at M, Causal.SingularRowsCauchy.sigma_separe_of_isCausal; the printed globally hyperbolic form is sigma_separe). The proof uses no flow. It runs on four facts: an inextensible causal curve through every point, Σ acausal, causal arc-connectedness, and Z⁻ = M ∖ sing₀. At BTZ points it also uses tarentin and the BTZ line. So the « In particular » does not depend on lem:vecteur or on theo:geroch_sing's splitting. Suggest: state it as a lemma of its own, before lem:image_diamant (l.2024). That proof uses M = J⁺(Σ) ∪ J⁻(Σ) (the recorded ordering finding), which this lemma provides (IsCauchySurface.cover_of_t1_secondCountable, needing only T1 and second countability).

ETT.tex:2071-2080 (the editorial proof), for a ψ-free rewrite: take a BTZ point p ∈ J⁺(Σ) ∖ Σ. There I⁻(p) = ∅, so no q ≪ p exists to give an open set I⁺(q) ⊆ J⁺(Σ). The neighbourhood comes instead from tarentin and from the BTZ half-line J⁻(p) = γ(]-∞, 0]): the line meets Σ at γ(s₀), s₀ < 0, and tarentin in M ∖ γ(]-∞, s₀]) gives a = γ(t), s₀ < t ≤ 0, with p ∈ Int J⁺(a) ⊆ J⁺(Σ) ∖ Σ. This case cannot be avoided. Every Cauchy surface of a causal singular flat spacetime with sing₀ ≠ ∅ has BTZ points in J⁺(Σ) ∖ Σ (SingularFlatAxioms.exists_mem_sing_zero_Jplus_diff; at E₀, SingularRowsCauchy.nonvacuous_e0, a BTZ point with I⁻(p) = ∅ and J⁺(S) ∈ 𝓝 p).

The « In particular » is read as four claims about Σ alone, proved for every Cauchy surface; the paper reaches them through ψ, and since the ψ-free statement implies the printed one, no reading is at stake. « Neighbourhood » is read as a member of 𝓝 y (not necessarily open). The stronger openness of J⁺(Σ) ∖ Σ is proved besides.
